'''Wisconsin Gas Lateral''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://graef-usa.com/we-energies-gas-lateral-ixonia-to-brookfield-and-germantown/|title=graef-usa.com|website=graef-usa.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Ixonia, Wisconsin to Germantown and Brookfield, Wisconsin.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.power-eng.com/gas/turbines/commissioners-vote-to-approve-wisconsin-gas-lateral-new-line-will-bring-competition-to-southeastern-wisconsin/|title=power-eng.com|website=power-eng.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://graef-usa.com/we-energies-gas-lateral-ixonia-to-brookfield-and-germantown/|title=graef-usa.com|website=graef-usa.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
